Explosion Radius is AoE GEOMETRY, and no StatKey expresses it — projectileExplosionPct is Projectile Explosion DAMAGE, a different mechanic — while the scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so radius is damage-inert regardless. RED under the nearest-wrong model that books 9.55 into the Damage Up bucket as projectileExplosionPct. S1b additionally scans every buffApply value so the magnitude cannot be smuggled in under a different stat.

it.skip S1c — the trigger itself is expressible (an RL's every shot is a full charge; shotFired is the nearest primitive), but its sole payload has no primitive and no observable at scope lock, so there is nothing to assert. Documented rather than silently dropped.

spec.assertion: it.skip S2c — the gate needs ≥5 simultaneous enemies. The sim fights ONE partless boss and has no enemy entity at all (resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns []), so the activation clause is structurally unreachable at scope lock. This is the gate that makes BOTH sub-lines below inert.

S2a (clearing skill2 is byte-identical) + S2b (no buffApply carries value 3.52, including the casterIdx===null/targetIdx===null boss-held-debuff path). Inert on two independent counts: the >4-enemies gate never fires, AND enemy DEF ▼ has no faithful primitive — defPct is SELF DEF and inert in v1, damageTakenPct is Damage Taken ▲, a different mechanic. RED under a model that encodes it as either.

spec.kitLine: Deals 14.96% of final ATK as add'l dmg
spec.assertion: S2a: clearing skill2 leaves every unit's total byte-identical. RED under the nearest-wrong model — dropping the enemy-count gate and re-keying the rider to shotFired/passive, which mints a per-shot 14.96%-of-final-ATK damage stream the game never delivers in a solo raid. This is the single highest-value anti-fudge assertion in the file: the rider is the only thing in belorta's non-burst kit that could plausibly be mis-modelled into real damage.

spec.kitLine: Deals 192% of final ATK as damage
spec.assertion: B1a: zeroing every burst-slot flatDamage.atkPct drops belorta's total — RED if the line is MISSING (zeroing a non-existent effect is a no-op). B1b inertness: the drop is strictly hers and strictly larger than any teammate's rotation-coupled ripple, RED if the 192% was authored onto an ally-targeted block. Trigger is burstCast→enemy; burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by construction (it lands before the FB window opens).

Four discriminators. B2a: the emitted buffApply value is the RAW 2.82 — chargeSpeedPct is a plain percentage stat, RED under a caster-scaled flat-resolve mis-encoding. B2b: exactly 5 distinct targetSlugs INCLUDING belorta, and applications factor as targets × casts (one uniform window per cast) — RED under allies-excludeSelf (4) or self-only (1). B2c: re-scoping the block to {kind:'self'} still moves a teammate's total while leaving belorta's own cadence untouched, isolating the ally grant from rotation ripple — RED under a self-only model. B2d: shrinking durationSec 10→1 costs belorta damage (she is a charge weapon, chargeFrames 90) — RED under a dropped/permanent duration or an inert buff. B2e: distinct expiresFrame count (= her cast count) is a STRICT SUBSET of fullBurstStart count — RED under a fullBurstEnter re-key, which would fire on every full burst. B2f inertness: chargeSpeedPct is the ONLY stat emitted from her caster slot.

fixtures: controlComp('belorta', true) for all six runs (baseline + five withPatchedOverride counterfactuals), deterministic, no seed. The fixed B3 slot is REQUIRED, not optional here: belorta is Burst II, so without a Burst III the chain never completes, no burst ever casts, and the entire burst group would be vacuous. The fixed B3 being a charge weapon is what makes the ally-scope counterfactual (B2c) observable on a teammate — a non-charge-weapon-only bench would leave chargeSpeedPct invisible outside belorta herself. KNOWN FIXTURE RISK, asserted rather than assumed: controlComp seats crown (Burst II) alongside belorta (Burst II) and only one unit takes stage 2 per chain, so B2a explicitly gates the group on belorta actually casting — if it fails, the finding is the fixture (no B2-free control comp exists), not the override. That same contest is what makes B2e's strict-subset burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter discriminator work.
gaps: it.skip S1c — Explosion Radius: no StatKey expresses AoE geometry (projectileExplosionPct is explosion DAMAGE, not radius), and the scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so even a faithful radius model would be damage-inert. Missing primitive + unobservable payload.

it.skip S2c — the '>4 enemy unit(s)' activation gate: needs ≥5 simultaneous enemies; the sim has one boss and no enemy entity (resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns []), so the trigger is structurally unreachable. Also records the second, independent gap: enemy DEF ▼ has no primitive (defPct = self DEF, inert; damageTakenPct = Damage Taken ▲, a different mechanic).

FIXTURE gap (not skipped — asserted at B2a): controlComp cannot give a Burst II carry an uncontested stage-2 slot, because crown occupies it. If B2a fails, a B2-free control comp is needed before any burst-slot claim about belorta can be graded.

Blind shape hedge: the packet documents the override slot value two ways (bare Block[] vs a CharacterSkills carrying .blocks). slotBlocks/clearSlot accept BOTH so a shape guess cannot produce a false RED; if the real shape is a third form, the counterfactual runs would silently become no-ops and B1a/B2c/B2d would fail — treat a simultaneous failure of those three as a harness-shape signal, not a model signal.

S1b/S2b scan buffApply VALUES globally (9.55 / 3.52 / 14.96), so a teammate coincidentally carrying one of those magnitudes would produce a false RED. Accepted: the magnitudes are 3-significant-figure kit constants and the counterfactual assertions (S1a/S2a) are the primary discriminators.
